video.description:
Learn to explain how to read values that arrive over time: For-Await Loop, AsyncSequence & AsyncStream, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
For-Await Loop - A loop written as `for await` that waits for each next value to arrive.
AsyncSequence - A sequence whose values arrive over time, so you read them with `await`.
AsyncStream - A ready-made stream of values over time that you fill with `yield` and close with `finish`.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Explain For-Await Loop, AsyncSequence & AsyncStream in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
For-Await Loop, AsyncSequence, AsyncStream 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

For-Await Loop - A loop written as `for await` that waits for each next value to arrive.
한국어: For-Await Loop: 다음 값이 도착할 때까지 기다리며 반복하는 for await 형태의 반복문

AsyncSequence - A sequence whose values arrive over time, so you read them with `await`.
한국어: AsyncSequence: 값이 시간에 걸쳐 도착하므로 await로 읽는 시퀀스

AsyncStream - A ready-made stream of values over time that you fill with `yield` and close with `finish`.
한국어: AsyncStream: yield로 값을 넣고 finish로 닫는, 시간에 걸쳐 값이 오는 기성 스트림

landscape.hook: Can you explain For-Await Loop, AsyncSequence and AsyncStream in English?

dialogue.title: Ticks over time
dialogue.setting: A view model that receives timer ticks

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I want to receive timer ticks in my view model with await. Should I use an AsyncStream?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. An AsyncStream is a ready-made stream of values over time.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How do I put values into it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Call `yield` for each value, like in `ticks`, and call `finish` at the end.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And how do I read the values?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: With a for-await loop. A for-await loop waits for each next value to arrive.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does it work with other sequences too?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, with every AsyncSequence. An AsyncSequence is a sequence whose values arrive over time.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So an array is not an AsyncSequence?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. An array has all its values already, so a normal for loop is enough.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What happens if I forget to call `finish`?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The for-await loop never ends, because it waits for another value.
A for-await loop waits for each value.
